title: Tree Row Default Icons
description: All tree items and tree sections must display an icon before the text. Use default folder/file icons when no explicit icon is provided.
summary: Tree sections and items now always render a `data-slot="tree-icon"` glyph before the label. Explicit `icon` props are preserved; otherwise sections and expandable rows use `FolderIcon`, leaves use `DocumentIcon` (12px, muted). Added vitest coverage for default icons on section/group/leaf rows. All 86 @semio-tech/ui-react tests pass.
